author: /root
scope: One selected-horse odds suffix connects existing JA/zh-CN/zh-TW label; no new translations or dictionary values.

review.method: Read exact source delta, MainGame weekly racetrack entry, Finish Board and result-row guards, LocaleManager legacy lookup and collector output. Verified shipped dictionary values and statically composed both pick states.
review.findings: Selected horses in JA/CN/TW use the existing 내 선택/My Choice pair; other languages retain MY PICK. Unselected rows stay suffix-free and the one-decimal odds, horse index, rank, styling, settlement and save flow are unchanged.

preservation.proof: Reversing the single suffix block restores RaceTrack.gd byte-exactly to baseline. Locale dictionaries and localization ledger are byte-exact; MainGame, demo and gameplay files were not changed.

validation: Static contract and collector/dictionary checks, demo and strict EN logs clean. Lane lists 22 selected checks only. No Godot or rendered test.
